goal: Migrate high-frequency checkout transaction processing to append-only event ledger with distributed deduplication
rationale: Direct row-level update on inventory tables causes lock contention under 10M concurrent users. An append-only ledger eliminates write locks.

invariants.assertion: Checkout mutations must insert append-only immutable journal records rather than updating existing ledger balances.
invariants.rationale: Preserves audit trail and eliminates hot-row database lock contention.
invariants.reassessment_threshold: Requires compliance team signoff and formal accounting audit.

invariants.assertion: Every incoming checkout request must validate unique transaction_token before journal dispatch.
invariants.rationale: Guarantees zero duplicate debit transactions during gateway retries.
invariants.reassessment_threshold: Requires proof of alternative idempotent wire protocol.

author: Mamdouh Aboammar
